=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_push_refspec_targets, the `if token in _PUSH_DELETE_FLAGS: return []` block | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When `--delete` appears after a push refspec has been collected, the parser returns no targets and skips checking the push refspec.
  WHY: A mixed push such as `git push origin HEAD:merged-branch --delete stale-branch` can push merged history without guard evaluation.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:git_subcommands and `_shell_segments_with_separators` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A `git push` inside a Bash `case` clause is not recognized as a guarded Git command.
  WHY: The tokenizer does not split on `)` and `case` is not handled as a reserved-word prefix, so guard evaluation is skipped. Severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this NIT; minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; the highest severity is high.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_UNRESOLVABLE_REFSPEC_MARKERS and `_unresolvable_refspec_reason` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `{` marker causes valid quoted Git reflog refspecs such as `feature/merged@{0}` to be treated as unresolvable.
  WHY: The guard falls back to judging the session checkout instead of the refspec’s actual source and destination, potentially allowing merged history to be pushed. Severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this NIT; minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; the highest severity is high.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:guard_targets, directory tracking block | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Directory tracking does not recognize `builtin cd` (or `command cd`) as a directory change.
  WHY: The walker judges a subsequent push from the previously tracked directory rather than the directory where the shell runs it. Severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and minimax_minimax-m3 rated this NIT; the other reviewers rated it MAJOR; the highest severity is high.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:587-655 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Relative `cd` resolution does not account for `CDPATH`.
  WHY: When `CDPATH` resolves a relative directory elsewhere, the guard can judge the push using a different repository from the one where it runs.
- docs/implement-plan/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo.md:lines 7, 10, and 14 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The progress log still describes the project as blocked waiting for the round-9 twin sync, even though the latest commit summary says that sync landed.
  WHY: A session or operator resuming from the log may wait for or repeat a sync that has already completed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The progress log header at docs/implement-plan/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo.md must accurately describe the current project state.
  expected_change_site: docs/implement-plan/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo.md lines 3-14
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The header says the round-9 `[claude-twin-sync]` is pending and names PR #5173 as still awaited, but commit 40001b5 landed the sync into `.claude/hooks/`.
- requirement: "Tests covering the acceptance list of #5144, including correct handling of every refspec shape the parser recognises" (PR description: "Tests: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` covers the parser and the worktree cases against real git repositories.")
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` — `test_unresolvable_refspecs_fall_back_to_the_session_checkout` and `test_deletions_tags_and_unguarded_calls_yield_no_target`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither test list covers a push refspec followed by `--delete`, a reflog-selector refspec, or a `case` clause, so the reported parser and command-walker bugs lack regression tests.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (and .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py)
  Line or code reference: _push_refspec_targets, the `if token in _PUSH_DELETE_FLAGS: return []` block
  severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A `--delete` flag after collected refspecs returns an empty target list and discards those refspecs.
  WHY: A push that includes a refspec before `--delete` can bypass the merged-PR check.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (and .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py)
  Line or code reference: git_subcommands and guard_targets, `_SHELL_PUNCTUATION_CHARS = ";&|\n<>"` and `_COMMAND_RESERVED_WORD_PREFIXES`
  severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: A `git push` inside a `case` clause is not recognized.
  WHY: `)` is not a command separator and `case` is not a reserved-word prefix, so the guard does not descend into the clause.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (and .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py)
  Line or code reference: _UNRESOLVABLE_REFSPEC_MARKERS includes `{`
  severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: A quoted reflog selector such as `feature/merged@{0}` triggers the unresolvable-refspec fallback.
  WHY: The guard judges the session checkout instead of the actual refspec.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (and .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py)
  Line or code reference: guard_targets, directory tracking block
  severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: `builtin cd /worktree` is not recognized as a directory change.
  WHY: The guard retains the old directory and may judge a push from the wrong repository.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The progress log header at docs/implement-plan/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo.md must accurately describe the current project state. The latest commit (`40001b5`) is a `[claude-twin-sync]` that copied the round-2 twin into `.claude/hooks/`.
  Expected change site: docs/implement-plan/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo.md lines 3-14
  Evidence of absence: The header reads `Status: BLOCKED until the [claude-twin-sync] commit for review round 9 lands (twin sha256 18d09f49...0786)`, `Waiting on: PR #5173: twin sync of the round-9 twin`, and `Last note: review round 9 ... The twin is now 18d09f49...0786 and the .claude/ copy 2c507cbb...d703 until the [claude-twin-sync] commit copies it`. The twin-sync commit `40001b5` has landed, updating the root copy. The header still describes the sync as pending. This was flagged in three prior review rounds.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `_push_refspec_targets`, the `if token in _PUSH_DELETE_FLAGS: return []` short-circuit (around new-file lines 760-770)
  severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: A `--delete` flag after collected refspecs discards every collected refspec and returns no target.
  WHY: The mixed push bypasses the merged-PR check, and the existing test only covers `--delete` before the refspec.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `git_subcommands` (the modified version at around new-file line 432-438) and `_shell_segments_with_separators` (around new-file line 270-310)
  severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: A `git push` inside a Bash `case` clause is never recognized as guarded.
  WHY: The tokenizer keeps the clause as one segment and `case` is not among the recognized reserved-word prefixes.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `_UNRESOLVABLE_REFSPEC_MARKERS = ("$", "`", "*", "?", "[", "{", "~")` (around new-file line 145) and `_unresolvable_refspec_reason` (around new-file line 870)
  severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A reflog selector such as `feature/merged@{0}` is treated as shell expansion and marked unresolvable.
  WHY: The guard falls back to the session checkout rather than checking the refspec’s source and destination.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `guard_targets` — the directory walker in the new file (around new-file line 1080-1100)
  severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The walker does not recognize `builtin cd /worktree` as a directory change.
  WHY: A subsequent push is judged from the session checkout rather than `/worktree`.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `_resolve_guard_path` (around new-file line 580-600)
  severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Relative `cd` resolution does not consult `$CDPATH`.
  WHY: The guard can track a different directory from the one Bash enters.
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Line or code reference: `_unresolvable_refspec_reason` (around new-file line 870-890), in concert with the `{` marker
  severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Reflog selectors and some refspecs containing `@` are treated as unresolvable and fall back to the session checkout.
  WHY: This masks the actual ref from the merged-PR check.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Tests covering the acceptance list of #5144, including correct handling of every refspec shape the parser recognises" (PR description: "Tests: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` covers the parser and the worktree cases against real git repositories.")
  Expected change site: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` — the new `test_unresolvable_refspecs_fall_back_to_the_session_checkout` and `test_deletions_tags_and_unguarded_calls_yield_no_target` parameterised lists
  Evidence of absence: Neither list covers the mixed `git push origin HEAD:<ref> --delete <other-ref>` shape, so the `--delete`-mid-push bug above has no regression pin. Neither list covers the reflog-selector refspec `feature/merged@{0}:feature/x` (or its source-only form), so the `{`-marker bug above has no regression pin. Neither list covers a `case` clause, so the case-clause bypass has no regression pin. The PR description claims acceptance-list coverage, but the three concrete shapes that the new code mishandles at runtime are not pinned
